answer: Sequential proof-of-time: every epoch each agent identity must publish a verifiable delay function output seeded by the new beacon, about 10 minutes of strictly serial squaring on one core. Steps: the beacon lands, each seat runs its VDF, verifiers check it in milliseconds, late seats earn nothing. Each step needs the previous one, so a farm cannot split it across a reef of GPUs or replay it after the next gale of fresh seeds. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 cores busy nonstop, about $5 per identity a month, and a clone that tries to wander between seats misses deadlines, so the attack stops paying.
